macros.name: egpaddtofigprelude
macros.doc: Define and add to a gnuplot prelude that is prepended to the output of every egp, egpx or egpdef environment.

macros.name: egpaddtoprelude
macros.doc: Define and add to the set of commands that are prepended to the top of every gnuplot file.

macros.name: egpfigprelude
macros.doc: Define and add to a gnuplot prelude that is prepended to the output of every egp, egpx or egpdef environment.

macros.name: egpwrite
macros.doc: Write gnuplot commands to the current file outside of a figure.

envs.name: egp
envs.doc: The egp as the egpx environment contains the description of a single figure that will be placed at the location of the environment.

envs.name: egpdef
envs.doc: The egpdef environment only defines a figure but does not include it into the document.

envs.name: egpx
envs.doc: The egp as the egpx environment contains the description of a single figure that will be placed at the location of the environment.
